reading: Essentially FLAT through the tank standoff (-0.2% on the day, worst dip -0.5% and it came BEFORE day 0); rose ~5% over the next five weeks. The crisis is invisible in the tape.

A shallow ~4% dip (55.59 on 19 Oct to the 53.49 low on 23 Oct); the low PRECEDED the most dangerous days (24-28 Oct) -- the market rose on 24 Oct as the blockade was enforced -- then rallied ~13% by day +25 and ~18% into December.
